privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Intro: When you register on the PerSe Coaching platform, we collect the following information:
section1List1: Password (stored encrypted, never kept as plain text)
privacy.section1Mid: The following may also be collected while using the platform:
section1List2: Program completion and workout progress data
privacy.section2Intro: We use the information we collect only for the following purposes:
section2List: Providing login and authentication to the platform
Connecting coaches and clients through programs, messages, and bookings
Tracking and displaying your workout progress
privacy.section2Outro: We do not sell your information to third parties or use it for advertising purposes.
privacy.section3P1: Your account information is stored in a secure MongoDB database. Passwords are stored encrypted using the bcrypt algorithm — we cannot see your password.
privacy.section3P2: Messaging data is stored in Google Firebase Firestore. Profile photos are uploaded to Firebase Storage.
privacy.section3P3: Your data is kept in the system until you delete your account. When you delete your account, your records in MongoDB are permanently deleted.
privacy.section4Intro: The platform uses the following third-party services:
privacy.section4Firebase: Real-time messaging and file storage. Firebase Privacy Policy: firebase.google.com/support/privacy
privacy.section4Mongo: Storage of user and program data.
privacy.section5P1: JWT-based authentication, encrypted password storage, and HTTPS communication are used to secure your data. However, we remind you that no data transmitted over the internet is 100% secure.
privacy.section6Intro: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.section6AccessDesc: Find out what data of yours is being kept
privacy.section6CorrectionDesc: You can update your information from your profile page
privacy.section6DeletionDesc: You can permanently delete your data using the "Delete Account" option on the settings page
privacy.section6ObjectionDesc: You have the right to object to the processing of your data
privacy.section7P1: The platform currently only uses browser localStorage for authentication purposes. No advertising or tracking cookies are used.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.section1P1: PerSe Coaching (the "Platform") is an intermediary platform that connects users ("Clients") with independent fitness coaches ("Coaches"). Through the Platform you can purchase programs, message your coach, schedule sessions, and track your progress.
terms.section1P2: Coaches are not employees or agents of the Platform; they are independent service providers. The Platform is responsible for the technical infrastructure connecting coach and client, not for the content of the service itself.
terms.section2Intro: To use the Platform, you must:
section2List: Provide accurate and up-to-date information when registering,
Be responsible for all activity that occurs under your account.
terms.section3P1: Program purchases and monthly/weekly/per-session coaching arrangements are processed securely through iyzico. Your payment details are not stored on Platform servers.
terms.section3P2: The Platform takes a commission on program sales, set out in a separate agreement between the coach and the Platform.
terms.section3P3: Refund requests are handled with the relevant coach or through our Contact page; each program's cancellation/refund policy may be set by the coach.
terms.section4Intro: When using the Platform, you agree not to:
section4List: Use another user's account without authorization,
Post harassing, abusive, or unlawful content through the Platform,
Attempt to damage the Platform's technical infrastructure (e.g. reverse engineering, automated data scraping).
terms.section5P1: The Platform's design, software, and brand belong to PerSe Coaching. Program content uploaded by coaches (exercises, videos, nutrition plans, etc.) belongs to the coach; the Platform only hosts this content to present it to the relevant client.
terms.section6P1: The Platform states that training or nutrition advice given by coaches does not constitute medical advice; evaluating its suitability for your health condition is your responsibility. If you have serious health concerns, consult your doctor before starting a training program.
terms.section6P2: The Platform does not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free.
terms.section7P1: We reserve the right to suspend or close your account if you violate these terms. You may also close your account yourself at any time from the Settings page.
terms.section8P1: We may update these terms from time to time. We will notify you of significant changes.
